about_the_game: Demon Hunt is an action rogue-lite game where you hunt down hordes of monsters to cleanse the cursed world. Equip devastating weapons with multiple upgrade branches and unique abilities. Upgrade your base to improve your arsenal and prepare for your next hunt!
